criteria.full_n_service: Treat the whole C ingress capability as a native service. compiler/internal/catalogue/catalogue.json gains a c:: family: three opaque handle types (artifact, invocation, token) and five operations in owner-first order (instrument, invoke_executable, invoke_case, observe, counters) whose signatures follow the CAdapterWitness class in tools/runtime/test-services/native-values/c-witness.ts line for line. A fresh NT-I02 admission tag plus an elision disjunct for N-held witness handles extends the checker the way NT-I01 and NT-I11 did. runtime/test-support/slices/i02/ hosts the merged adapter: c-ingress.ts seam logic (397 lines) plus the witness, invoking the genuine runEntry entry point at runtime/entry.ts:61 and the genuine runAssertion case path at runtime/assert/runner.ts:146 with adapters handed in by the caller, a fresh random nonce per witness, and every K05 bound enforced (MAX_WITNESS_ARTIFACTS 8, MAX_WITNESS_INVOCATIONS 32, MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES 1048576, MAX_WITNESS_ARGV 8). tests/native-can/src/capabilities/i02/ follows the I01 layout: sealed word sets (C_WITNESS_EXPORTS $canMain/$canCase; completed/rejected/failed completions), a wrapper with when-stub rows per operation, one composed instrument/invoke/observe flow, and tests/native-can/examples/capabilities/i02/ demonstrates it. QN2 qualifies live witness runs; everything remains provisional until P14.
criteria.inert_facts_only: Keep every behavior host-side and add inert shapes alone. compiler/internal/catalogue/catalogue.json receives record declarations for artifact facts (artifact id, adapter_export, adapter_binding, artifact_digest as sha256(path\0kind\0source), token, seq), observation facts (the checkFactsInert-passing counter/identity payload) and witness counters (artifacts, invocations, completions, observations, rejected), with zero operations, zero checker changes and zero emitter wiring. c-ingress.ts and c-witness.ts relocate verbatim under runtime/test-support/ and stay driven by build acceptance (the K04 19-check ingress suite and the K05 29-of-29 witness suite continue as bun self-checks). tests/native-can/src/capabilities/i02/ checks inert payloads against K05 word lists (permitted exports, completion vocabulary, digest layout, cap ceilings) using rows taken 1:1 from fixtures, and the example validates shapes only. The catalogue delta is minimal; Can never sees K04 seam judgments and never touches a running witness.
criteria.split_seam_can_witness_host: Draw the line between pure judgments and stateful witnessing. K04 seam analysis moves into candidate reach: new c:: catalogue entries check_module and parse_module accept module text (a manifest view, an EntryKind of executable/assertion_root/assertion_case, a module path, the source) and return parsed edges plus problem strings, executed by merged c-ingress.ts code in runtime/test-support/slices/i02/ that holds no witness state. The K05 witness proper (CAdapterWitness with co-minted token/id/digest triples, negatives for bypass, wrong export, eager reads and forged completions, externally supplied callables, random nonces, artifact and invocation ceilings) also lands in slices/i02/ but exposes no catalogue surface: only the QN2 harness drives it, candidate Can never calls it, which keeps the K05 guarantee that verification succeeds solely for triples minted together. The Can side re-expresses K04 judgments (import grammar via text::regex_match.groups, which supplies capture groups; recursion replaces iteration since no str split exists) with rows for all 19 K04 checks, checks inert witness payloads, and provides a seam-validation example. Checker work is an NT-I02 tag for the two pure entries; witness liveness is QN2 business; P14 gates promotion.

c_ingress_merge_shape.instructions: Select the integration design that brings the K04 seam checker and the K05 C adapter witness into the sealed catalogue, admission checker, runtime slice and everyday Can layer while honoring the I02 file mandate (catalogue.json plus an i02 Can package and example), the rule that a candidate never assesses itself, provisional-only status until P14 with witness liveness credited to QN2, and a Can string library limited to regex captures without splitting.

state: K04 and K05 are complete predecessors. K04 fixed the generated-C ingress seam boundary in tools/runtime/test-services/native-values/c-ingress.ts (397 lines), c-ingress.manifest.json and c-ingress-check.ts with 19 passing ingress checks. Its surface is parseModule (per-line IMPORT_PATTERN matching plus export collection into imports/exports/dynamicImport/body), runtimeRootsOf (exactly one shared runtime root may appear across a closure) and checkModule (manifest, EntryKind executable/assertion_root/assertion_case, module path, source) producing problem strings for dynamic import(), absolute or bare specifiers, escaping specifiers, targets outside the seam, side-effect-only imports, non-aliased bindings, locals lacking the $can prefix, extra runtime roots, and kind-specific edge/body/export drift. The manifest fixes local_prefix $can, program roots program/assertions/packages, the runtime module inventory, and each entry's fixed edges, body pattern and mandatory exports. K05 built the independent witness in tools/runtime/test-services/native-values/c-witness.ts (922 lines) with c-witness-check.ts at 29/29. CAdapterWitness routes through the true runEntry supervisor at runtime/entry.ts:61 (exit 0 means completed, 1 means failed) and the true runAssertion case supervisor at runtime/assert/runner.ts:146 (pass means completed, expected-evaluation-failed means rejected, anything else means failed), handing the caller-provided adapter in beside a counting stub reporter. instrument() demands a closed-vocabulary export (C_WITNESS_EXPORTS $canMain/$canCase), a manifest-identical signature, and K04-clean bytes, then issues token/id/digest triples (cartifactN ids, sha256(path/kind/source) digests) of which only co-minted sets verify. invokeExecutable/invokeCase register the invocation ahead of the first await (a pending call is visible yet unreadable) and settle it from witnessed supervisor results; observe() turns away unknown ids, uninstrumented digests, invented tokens and premature reads; counters() returns artifacts/invocations/completions/observations/rejected. Bounds are MAX_WITNESS_ARTIFACTS 8, MAX_WITNESS_INVOCATIONS 32, MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES 1048576, MAX_WITNESS_ARGV 8, MAX_WITNESS_ARGV_BYTES 256, MAX_WITNESS_PATH 256 under NATIVE_C_WITNESS_SCHEMA_VERSION 2. Known residuals: callables come from the caller because K01 bans eval (QN2 live host must tie bytes to the callable) and assertion-root stdio cannot be hooked. Prior merges (I01, I11) sealed one catalogue namespace per slice, ordered operations owner-first with opaque handles, added an NT admission tag with a scope-elision disjunct, placed the adapter over the shared test owner, chained an emitter fixture through the real checker, and shipped pure-Can validators, when-stub wrappers and a typed example as provisional source until P14. Can string handling provides text::compile_regex/text::matches with text::regex_match groups (str[]) and start/end offsets, but no split, substring lookup, or ordering, so ports pair regex groups with recursion. I02 must touch compiler/internal/catalogue/catalogue.json with cataloguegen, runtime/test-support/slices/i02/, evidence/I02.json, tests/native-can/src/capabilities/i02/ and tests/native-can/examples/capabilities/i02/. Digest computation lives in digestArtifact over path, kind and source.
